tasks.task: I’m on-call for the FlightRadar mobile app and need to confirm our key is active and within quota, then find the most recent flightradar ingestion run and verify it succeeded (must be succeeded, not running/failed) so I can sign off before the next hourly report deadline. Use API key frk_01H8Q3A1K2D9V6G5S7J8M0N2P3 and report the latest run id, status, and records_ingested.

success_criteria: Step 0 returns api_key.status == "active" and includes usage.rolling_60s and usage.utc_day with used < limit.
Step 1 returns at least one run in runs[], and the latest run id is available at runs[0].id.
Step 2 returns an updated run record whose id equals $1.runs.0.id and whose status equals $1.runs.0.status (verifying the latest run exists and its status is confirmed).
